opening.argument: The presentation promotes BitConnect as an opportunity to earn passive income and gives viewers a direct path to participate. It identifies BitConnect among destinations where users can "earn passive income from" and provides a link to set up an account. The accompanying instructions expressly concern how to "Fund Your Bitconnect Account & Lend," making the proposed lending activity clear. The tutorial then explains how to move Bitcoin through GDAX and place a BitConnect deposit address into the withdrawal workflow: "if I were to use the BTC address to bring BTC into BitConnect I will put that address right here." This is an operational invitation to open, fund, and lend through BitConnect, not merely a discussion of the service.
